brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for a grandparent preparing their home for visits from a young grandchild. Make the practical benefit relevant to visits without promising worry-free visits, universal compatibility or easy installation. This is a hypothetical audience scenario, not customer research.

variants.primary_text: When you prepare your home for a young grandchild's visit, a few thoughtful childproofing steps can help get the space ready for little explorers. The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes edge/corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet/fridge locks and door guards for Indian homes. Get 1-to-1 installation video support. Adult supervision is still necessary.

variants.primary_text: Grandparenting prep can start before the visit.
